hooks.style: The first 3 seconds are crucial. Start with a shocking statement, a question that creates curiosity, or a visual that demands attention. Cut out any unnecessary introductions. Immediately jump into the core of the content.
hooks.firstThreeSeconds: Must create immediate curiosity or shock

focus: Revealing hidden secrets in different fields (finance, retail, etc.)
Anecdotes of people breaking the rules and succeeding (career or life).
Specific tricks or secrets that benefit the average viewer.
Insider Secrets (e.g., company secrets, expert tips, hidden knowledge)
Stories of people breaking rules and succeeding (or facing consequences)
Exposing injustices or manipulative tactics (e.g., gaslighting, sales tricks)
avoid: General self-help or motivational content without a specific, novel angle
Content lacking a clear and compelling narrative
Generic statements about wealth or success.
Content lacking a clear and immediate benefit for the viewer.
General advice on wealth or lifestyle changes
Vague or philosophical topics (e.g., confidence, truth)
Any topic that lacks a clear, compelling hook in the first 3 seconds

titles.guidance: Use strong, attention-grabbing words (e.g., SHOCKING, SECRET, EXPOSED, CRAZY). Incorporate relevant emojis to enhance visual appeal. Keep titles concise and to the point.

posting.guidance: Experiment with posting times to identify when your audience is most active. Consistency is key. Aim for at least 1-3 videos per day, but don't sacrifice quality for quantity.
